info.name: Backblaze B2 Cloud Storage Native API (Corrected v3)
info.description:
Corrected version of the Backblaze B2 Native API Postman collection.

Changes vs the original (collection 6x28qrl, last published 2024-10-19):
- Storage endpoints upgraded to /b2api/v4/.
- Partner API endpoints upgraded to /b2api/v3/.
- b2_authorize_account test script captures every variable downstream requests need (apiUrl, downloadUrl, s3ApiUrl, groupsApiUrl, recommendedPartSize, absoluteMinimumPartSize).
- All raw JSON bodies are valid JSON (no JS comments, no trailing commas).
- b2_create_key uses bucketIds (array) per v4 schema.
- b2_upload_file: SHA-1 defaults to do_not_verify; modern Object Lock / SSE / file-info headers are present (disabled).
- Hardcoded sample IDs replaced with placeholders.
- Empty query placeholders (?bucketId=, &groupId=) replaced with {{variables}}.
- Added 23 missing endpoints: full bucket lifecycle, file listing/metadata, object lock, copy/hide, downloads-by-id, download authorization, full large-file workflow, b2_set_bucket_notification_rules.
- All collection variables declared with descriptions and empty defaults.
- Top-level raw Authorization header using {{authorizationToken}} with no Bearer prefix; per-request overrides only on b2_authorize_account (Basic), b2_upload_file, and b2_upload_part.

Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs

## v2 changes (post live-test)
- b2_create_key: dropped "namePrefix": "" default (Finding D — was 500 internal_error).
- b2_list_keys: dropped "startApplicationKeyId": "" default (Finding B — was 400 bad_request).
- b2_list_buckets: added a request-description note flagging the scoped-key 401 (Finding A).
- b2_list_file_versions: dropped "startFileId": "" default (Finding E — was 400 bad_request).
- b2_list_unfinished_large_files: dropped "startFileId": "" default (Finding E — was 400 bad_request).
- Round 3 verified: b2_get_download_authorization's "fileNamePrefix": "" is accepted (means "any file"); empty `prefix`, `startFileName`, and `namePrefix` (in list operations) are also accepted. Only `startFileId`, `startApplicationKeyId`, and `namePrefix` in b2_create_key are rejected.
- Partner API list endpoints now use `groupsApiUrl`; `b2_reserve_trial_create_account` uses the documented array body shape.
- Backblaze Groups are treated as existing website-created resources; this collection does not include or imply an API to create Groups.

## v3 changes (safer default examples)
- b2_create_bucket default body is now minimal and omits `replicationConfiguration`; replication examples must include `asReplicationSource` and/or `asReplicationDestination`.
- b2_update_bucket default body now updates only `bucketType`; omit lifecycle/CORS/info fields unless intentionally replacing them, and use `ifRevisionIs` only with a real current revision.
- b2_upload_part now requires `{{partSha1}}`; the same SHA-1 must be supplied to b2_finish_large_file.
- Object Lock retention examples use `{{retainUntilTimestamp}}` instead of a stale fixed timestamp.
- Partner API descriptions clarify `memberEmail`/alias mapping, eject consequences, and B2 Reserve trial units.

item.name: Authentication

request.description:
Logs in to the B2 API. Returns an authorization token plus the per-suite endpoints (`storageApi.apiUrl`, `storageApi.downloadUrl`, `groupsApi.groupsApiUrl`, etc.) via the nested `apiInfo` field.

Uses HTTP Basic auth with `applicationKeyId:applicationKey`. The test script populates every collection variable used by the rest of the requests, so run this first.

Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-authorize-account

exec: // Capture every variable downstream requests need.

item.description: Run b2_authorize_account first. Its test script captures all the per-suite endpoints and tokens used by the rest of the collection.

request.description:
Lists buckets associated with an account, in alphabetical order by bucket name. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-list-buckets

**v2 note (Finding A from live testing):** if you authorize with an application key restricted to a specific bucket, this request returns 401 unless the body also includes `"bucketId": "{{bucketId}}"` (or `"bucketName": "{{bucketName}}"`). Master keys aren't affected. Uncomment / add the field below if you're using a scoped key.

Creates a new bucket using a minimal safe request body. Optional settings such as bucketInfo, CORS rules, lifecycle rules, Object Lock, server-side encryption, and replication can be added deliberately when needed. Do not include an empty replicationConfiguration object; replicationConfiguration must include asReplicationSource and/or asReplicationDestination. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-create-bucket

Updates an existing bucket using a minimal safe example. Omitted fields remain unchanged. Do not include lifecycleRules, corsRules, bucketInfo, defaultRetention, defaultServerSideEncryption, or replicationConfiguration unless this request is intentionally replacing that setting. Only include ifRevisionIs when you have the current bucket revision from b2_list_buckets/b2_get_bucket; a stale or placeholder revision causes a conflict. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-update-bucket
Deletes a bucket. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-delete-bucket
Gets a URL + auth token for uploading files to a specific bucket. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-get-upload-url

header.description: Use b2/x-auto to let B2 detect, or set explicitly (e.g. application/octet-stream).
SHA-1 of the file content. Use 'do_not_verify' if you cannot precompute the hash; Postman cannot reliably hash binary uploads in a pre-request script.
Override upload timestamp (ms since epoch). Requires the writeFileTimestamps capability.
'on' or 'off'. Requires Object Lock to be enabled on the bucket.
Future Unix timestamp in milliseconds for Object Lock retention. Disabled by default.
SSE-B2: AES256. Use Customer-* headers below for SSE-C.

request.description:
Uploads a single file (≤ 5 GB) to the URL returned by b2_get_upload_url.

**X-Bz-Content-Sha1**: defaults to `do_not_verify` because Postman cannot reliably hash a binary body in a pre-request script. To enable verification, precompute the SHA-1 of the file and replace this header value, or use the SDKs/CLI which hash on the fly.

Most modern features (Object Lock, SSE, custom file-info) are present below as **disabled** headers; enable the ones you need.

Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-upload-file
Lists the names of all files in a bucket. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-list-file-names

Lists all versions of all files in a bucket. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-list-file-versions

**v2 note (Finding E from live testing):** the `startFileId` field has been removed from the default body. Sending it as an empty string returns HTTP 400. Add it back only when paginating, with the value of `nextFileId` from a previous response.
Gets information about a single file. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-get-file-info
Downloads a file by name. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-download-file-by-name
Downloads a file by file ID. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-download-file-by-id
Generates a download token usable in URLs without exposing the master auth token. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-get-download-authorization
Server-side copy of a B2 file. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-copy-file
Hides a file (creates a hide-marker version). Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-hide-file
Deletes a single file version. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-delete-file-version
Updates the legal-hold setting on a file version. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-update-file-legal-hold
Updates the retention setting on a file version. Set retainUntilTimestamp to a future Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-update-file-retention

item.name: Large File Operations
item.description: Multipart upload workflow: start → get_upload_part_url → upload_part (×N) → finish. Use list_unfinished_large_files / cancel to clean up.

request.description: Begins a multipart upload. Returns a fileId used for subsequent part operations. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-start-large-file
Gets a URL + auth token for uploading parts of a large file. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-get-upload-part-url

header.description: Postman auto-sets this; provided here for documentation.
Required SHA-1 checksum of this part. Precompute it and pass the same value to b2_finish_large_file.

request.description: Uploads one part of a large file. X-Bz-Content-Sha1 is required for each part; precompute the SHA-1 of the exact part bytes and pass the same checksum in b2_finish_large_file.partSha1Array. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-upload-part
Copies bytes from an existing file as a part of a large-file upload. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-copy-part
Lists parts that have been uploaded for a large file. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-list-parts

Finalizes a large-file upload. partSha1Array must contain the SHA-1 checksum for each uploaded part, in part-number order, matching the values used in b2_upload_part. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-finish-large-file
Cancels a large-file upload, deleting any parts already uploaded. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-cancel-large-file

Lists in-progress large-file uploads. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-list-unfinished-large-files

**v2 note (Finding E from live testing):** the `startFileId` field has been removed from the default body. Sending it as an empty string returns HTTP 400. Add it back only when paginating, with the value of `nextFileId` from a previous response.

item.name: Application Key Management
item.description: Application keys control access to your B2 account. See https://www.backblaze.com/cloud-storage/api/application-keys for the master-key console.

request.description:
Creates a new application key. There is a limit of 100 million key creations per account.

v4 schema uses **bucketIds** (array). The legacy v2 `bucketId` (singular) is no longer accepted.

Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-create-key

**v2 note (Finding D from live testing):** the `namePrefix` field has been removed from the default body. Sending it as an empty string causes the v4 API to return HTTP 500 internal_error. Add it back only when you actually need a non-empty key-name prefix.
Deletes the application key specified. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-delete-key

Lists application keys associated with an account. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-list-keys

**v2 note (Finding B from live testing):** the `startApplicationKeyId` field has been removed from the default body. Sending it as an empty string causes a 400 `bad_request: invalid application key ID:` error. Add it back only when paginating, with a real key ID copied from a previous response's `nextApplicationKeyId`.

item.name: Event Notification Rules
item.description: Backblaze B2 Event Notifications (GA in 2024) lets you trigger workflows when files are uploaded, deleted, etc. See https://www.backblaze.com/docs/cloud-storage-event-notifications-reference-guide

request.description: Gets the notification rules for a bucket. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-get-bucket-notification-rules
Sets the notification rules for a bucket. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-set-bucket-notification-rules

item.name: Partner API
item.description: The Partner API lets you provision and manage Backblaze B2 accounts within an existing Backblaze Group. Groups must be created in the Backblaze web console after Groups/Partner API enablement; this collection does not provide a create-Group API. Authentication uses the same b2_authorize_account; the test script captures `groupsApiUrl` from `apiInfo.groupsApi`. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/introduction-to-the-partner-api

request.description: Creates a new Backblaze account and adds it to an existing managed Group. Neocloud account alias maps to the Partner API memberEmail field. The memberEmail must be syntactically valid and must not already be a Backblaze account email. Groups themselves are created in the Backblaze website, not through this API. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-create-group-member

Ejects a Group member. The account is not deleted, existing application keys continue to function, and the ejected account cannot be re-added to any Group using the Partner API. Treat this as a high-friction/deprovisioning operation, not a reversible suspend. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-eject-group-member
Lists active Backblaze Groups for an authorized Group admin. Groups are created in the Backblaze web console, not by this API. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-list-groups
Lists active Group members for a specific existing groupId. Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-list-group-members

Creates one or more Backblaze B2 accounts and starts B2 Reserve trials. Request body is an array. term is the trial duration in days (7-30 inclusive); storage is TB (1-50 inclusive). Docs: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-reserve-trial-create-account
